owner_intent: Analyze spot and futures components and compare them together in one joint asset-level conclusion; aligned pressure can support a stronger signal.
requirements: Trading futures does not limit analytical inputs to futures; include useful spot evidence.
Preserve venue and market provenance while combining compatible spot/futures evidence in a joint conclusion.
Compare the exact same asset over aligned complete windows, with original source clocks and verified units/contract multipliers.
For trade flow compare aggressive buy/sell imbalance; each execution has both a buyer and seller, so this is not net capital entering the market.
For N05 qualify independent actual venues, same direction and comparable normalized strength; HTX-only evidence is not multi-venue consensus.
Retain market-specific aggregates and disagreement flags; a larger futures turnover must not conceal contradictory spot pressure.
Missing data is unknown, not zero, agreement, a bearish reading, or permission to require all blocks or markets.
Do not double-count copied feeds, common upstreams or the same physical fact across blocks as independent confirmation.
Onchain exchange deposits/withdrawals from Nansen remain a separate contextual metric; do not add token quantities to quote-denominated taker turnover.
Funding, open interest and liquidations remain derivatives-specific; spot context can inform the joint conclusion without fabricating spot equivalents.

proposed_diagnostic_not_calibrated.market_imbalance: (aggressive_buy_quote - aggressive_sell_quote) / (aggressive_buy_quote + aggressive_sell_quote), only with validated positive denominator

scope: Other actually connected venues after inventory verification
